status: proposed integration decisions; source inventories and runtime are unchanged
basis: Full comparison of the 16 shared IDs across the original seed and the three research inventories. Ten groups have identical definitions and parents. Six action IDs differ in wording or scope.
rules: Never use last-write-wins to choose a meaning from conflicting source records.
Retain original source record, source hash and qualified source ID for every accepted node or relation.
Research-source IDs are not an instruction to rewrite historical runtime definitions.
Existing five technical bootstrap IDs are independent; no implicit alias is made between work and area.work, or reading and area.reading.
A narrower action may be chosen without removing the broader personal activity. Automatic reclassification of existing sessions is not authorized.

actionResolutions.reason: The original explicitly includes applications and CV work; the research label supplies examples of the same job-search family. Keep the broad meaning and original parent. Specific interview or CV-writing actions can remain independently selectable when requested.
Both sources explicitly cover personal diary and reflection. Keep original definition and parent; remove source-only seed suffix from display aliases.
Original examples already include a teacher-led lesson and a language course. The new wording does not establish a distinct action.

actionResolutions.researchDefinitionRu: Создавать первичный связный текст или новый фрагмент произведения, документа либо сообщения. Небольшие правки по ходу допустимы; отдельный проход изменения уже написанного текста относится к редактуре или переработке.
actionResolutions.reason: The original label includes both writing and editing. Narrowing that ID to first-draft composition would lose its original scope.

actionResolutions.researchDefinitionRu: Составлять текст адресованного другому человеку письма или сообщения, включая обдумывание ответа и правку перед отправкой. Чтение входящей переписки или разбор почты может входить в более широкую личную карточку переписки, но не считается здесь самостоятельным написанием.
actionResolutions.reason: Correspondence can cover reading and exchange; the new source definition explicitly describes composing an outgoing letter.

actionResolutions.researchDefinitionRu: Участвовать в разговорном обмене на изучаемом языке с партнёром, преподавателем или собеседником. Самостоятельный монолог, отработка произношения и повторение записи имеют отдельные действия; роль собеседника и канал общения выбираются при необходимости.
actionResolutions.reason: Original conversation examples also included pronunciation and shadowing. Preserve this historical proposal rather than silently making those earlier examples invalid; new conversational-exchange subtype is precise.

remaining: Apply references using qualified source + sourceId, not blind global string replacement.
